data.value: Indie game marketing with no upfront cost

data.value: PubPot connects indie developers with small creators: a share of net Steam revenue during the launch window instead of upfront costs. Sign up for the Steam Next Fest 2027 pilot.

data.name: How.Step1.Title
data.value: Register your game

data.name: How.Step2.Title

data.name: How.Step3.Text

data.name: Dev.Eyebrow
data.value: For developers

data.name: Dev.Title
data.value: Reach at launch – with no upfront cost

data.name: Dev.Lead
data.value: Marketing usually costs money before a game earns any. PubPot flips that around: you share part of the revenue with the creators who show your game.

data.name: Dev.Point1
data.value: No upfront costs: you only give a share of net Steam revenue during the launch window.

data.name: Dev.Point2
data.value: No publisher deal: your IP and your decisions stay with you.

data.name: Dev.Point3
data.value: Honest impressions: critical reviews count too. Creators aren't paid for good reviews.

data.name: Dev.Point4
data.value: No platform fee during the pilot.

data.name: Creator.Eyebrow
data.value: For creators

data.name: Creator.Title
data.value: Play new indie games – and share in the revenue

data.name: Creator.Lead
data.value: Sponsorships usually only start once a channel reaches a certain size. PubPot is deliberately aimed at small channels: you play indie games and get a share of the pool that matches your reach.

data.name: Creator.Point1
data.value: Made for small channels: mainly Twitch streams with fewer than 50 average viewers and small YouTube channels.

data.name: Creator.Point2
data.value: Your opinion stays yours: critical reviews count too.

data.name: Creator.Point3
data.value: Transparent: your content about the game is labelled as advertising.

data.name: Creator.Point4
data.value: No guaranteed amount: what you get depends on sales and your reach.

data.name: Creator.Point5
data.value: You must be 18 or older.

data.name: Pilot.Title

data.name: Pilot.Text
data.value: We're starting small: with 3 to 5 games and 20 to 30 creators. There's no platform fee during the pilot, and we handle payouts by hand. That way we find out together what works.

data.name: Faq.Title
data.value: Frequently asked questions

data.name: Faq.Cost.Q
data.value: What does PubPot cost developers?

data.name: Faq.Cost.A
data.value: Nothing upfront. You put a share of your net Steam revenue from the launch window into the pool, by default 25% for 3 months. There's no platform fee during the pilot.

data.name: Faq.Publisher.Q
data.value: Do I have to sign a publisher deal?

data.name: Faq.Publisher.A
data.value: No. PubPot isn't a publisher. Your IP and all decisions about your game stay with you.

data.name: Faq.Who.Q
data.value: Who can join as a creator?

data.name: Faq.Who.A
data.value: We're mainly looking for small channels: Twitch streamers with fewer than 50 average viewers and small YouTubers. You must be at least 18.

data.name: Faq.Positive.Q
data.value: Do I have to review the game positively?

data.name: Faq.Positive.A
data.value: No. Critical reviews count too. All that matters is that you show the game honestly.

data.name: Faq.Split.Q
data.value: How is the pool split?

data.name: Faq.Split.A
data.value: By reach: whoever reaches more people gets a bigger share. During the pilot, we handle payouts by hand.

data.name: Faq.Earn.Q
data.value: How much will I earn as a creator?

data.name: Faq.Earn.A
data.value: We can't predict that. The size of the pool depends on the game's sales, and your share depends on your reach. Think of it as a little extra on the side, not an income.

data.name: Faq.Ad.Q
data.value: Do I have to label my content as advertising?

data.name: Faq.Ad.A
data.value: Yes. Because you get a share of the revenue, you label your content about the game as advertising.

data.name: Faq.Data.Q
data.value: What happens to my data?

data.name: Faq.Data.A
data.value: We only use your details to get in touch with you. Your sign-up only counts once you confirm it by email. We delete unconfirmed sign-ups after 30 days. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.

data.name: Faq.Data.Link
data.value: Read the privacy policy

data.name: Faq.Live.Q
data.value: Has PubPot launched yet?

data.name: Faq.Live.A
data.value: Not yet. We're preparing a pilot with a small number of games and creators. Signing up lets us know you're interested. Places in the pilot are limited.

data.name: Join.Title
data.value: Interested in the pilot?

data.name: Join.Lead
data.value: Signing up is free and doesn't commit you to anything.
